Huh. I just realized that while I had subscribed to the Quantum Information channel, I somehow missed this one.

A bit earlier, I made a post #Quantum information > Quantum Computing: Organizing the community that overlaps somewhat with this topic, as it asks for quantum computing repositories. (And adding a pointer to our own).

It goes a bit beyond this topic, in that I'm trying to gauge interest in building a common framework for formalizing quantum computing. If this sounds good to you, please leave a message in the other thread!
